units.source_text: 腊尽春回之后，营造及祝寿的筹备越发加紧。

en.t: After the last month of winter had ended and spring returned, preparations for the building work and the birthday celebration became even more urgent.

units.source_text: 安排法会后的贺宴，选定乐人与舞手等事，皆由源氏亲自操心。

en.t: Genji personally took charge of such matters as arranging the banquet after the Buddhist service and choosing the musicians and dancers.

units.source_text: 经卷与佛像、举行法会时所需的装束，以及犒赏品等，皆由紫姬用心准备。

en.t: Lady Murasaki carefully prepared the sutra scrolls and Buddhist images, the garments needed for the service, the reward gifts, and other items.

units.source_text: 住在东院的花散里也分担一部分工作。

en.t: Hanachirusato, who lived in the eastern residence, also took on part of the work.

units.source_text: 紫姬与花散里交情亲密，两人和睦共处，欢笑度日。

en.t: Lady Murasaki and Hanachirusato were close friends; the two lived together in harmony and passed their days with laughter.
